author: betelgeuse

notes: [  6  ] VILLAGER @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ ON SHEEP @resource/sheep.webp@
RALLY NEXT [  2  ] VILLAGERS @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ ON TREE NEAR BASE @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
[  1  ] VILLAGER (any)  @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ TO BUILD @abilities/repair.webp@ HOUSE OF WISDOM @landmark_abbasid/house-of-wisdom.webp@ *NEAR BASE ---->>>

---->>> THEN SAME VILLAGER @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ BUILD@abilities/repair.webp@ HOUSE @building_economy/house.webp@ + MINING CAMP @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ ON STONE @resource/resource_stone.webp@
*** build mining camp last and put everything close so villager dont waste time ***
*** after finishing building mining camp put that villager on stone using shift command ***
RALLY NEXT [  4  ] VILLAGERS  @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ -> STONE @resource/resource_stone.webp@
*** 1st builder finished house of wisdom and started building house
AFTER FINISHING @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @abilities/repair.webp@BUILDING VILLAGER ---->>> GOES TO MINING CAMP @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ ON STONE@resource/resource_stone.webp@

*** If you made everything right 1st villager that will start mining stone will finish gathering 10stone before mining camp finishes building --->> so you need to right click on mine camp with that villager when he finishes gathering or you will waste some time ***
AGE UP CULTURAL WING  @age/age_2.webp@@technology_ayyubids/culture-wing-advancement-1.webp@
!!! DON'T cancel Villager [#10] and [#11] to do faster age up -- Make sure you have enough food to -- ALWAYS produce new villagers and don't forget to queue them !!!

WHEN [  4  ] VILLAGERS @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ ON STONE @resource/resource_stone.webp@---->>> MOVE [  1  ] VILLAGER @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ FROM SHEEP @resource/sheep.webp@ TO STRAGGLER TREE @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ !!!!!! BUT REMOVE ONLY WHEN YOU HAVE NEXT VILLAGER QUEUED UP !!!!!!!
RALLY NEW VILLAGERS @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @resource/rally.webp@ ---->>> ON WOOD @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ UNTILL [  7  ]
***Make sure you rally on the last tree with most wood in it so your villagers don't spend extra time to run around the base***
Age up @age/age_2.webp@ Completed at 2:50 - 3:00
AFTER 7 ON WOOD --->>> @resource/rally.webp@-> @resource/sheep.webp@ UNTILL 8
1) WHEN [  900  ]  STONE LEFT IN STONE MINE  @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@  @resource/resource_stone.webp@  FORCE DROP RESOURCES with 4 VILLAGERS
OR
2) WHEN YOU HAVE [  300  ] STONE  @resource/resource_stone.webp@
-> TAKE ALL [  4   ] VILLAGERS @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ FROM STONE MINE @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ @resource/resource_stone.webp@
->  TAKE [  5  ]  VILLAGERS @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ FROM WOOD @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@
--->>> BUILD @abilities/repair.webp@ SECOND TC @building_economy/town-center.webp@  (BUILD ON WOOD/GOLD, BOTH - PERFECT)
*** try to leave area for @building_economy/farm.webp@ near both @building_economy/town-center.webp@ ***
*** shift command builders to gather near wood ***
@resource/rally.webp@ NEW VILLAGERS ON WOOD @resource/resource_wood.webp@
WHEN THERE IS NO MORE STRAGG TREES @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ MOVE [  2  ] VILL @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ --->>> TO @resource/sheep.webp@

2ND @building_economy/town-center.webp@ IS FINISHED, MOVE BUILDERS@unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@  --->>>TO @resource/resource_wood.webp@ NEAR 2ND @building_economy/town-center.webp@ (we save wood for lumber camp)
@resource/rally.webp@ ---->>> @resource/resource_gold.webp@ UNTILL [  3  ]

1st  @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ BUILD @building_economy/mill.webp@ ON @resource/berrybush.webp@ THEN ---->>> BUILD @abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/mining-camp.webp@  ON @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (consider @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ for both)
THEN BUILDER @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@@abilities/repair.webp@ GOES TO --->>> @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ @resource/resource_gold.webp@
(Building whatever you decided depending your strategy, read below)
@resource/rally.webp@ ->@resource/resource_food.webp@ UNTILL [  20-22 ] to produce villagers and army without problems
TO AGE UP SPLIT VILLAGERS FROM WOOD @resource/resource_wood.webp@ ---->>> TO FOOD @resource/resource_food.webp@ AND GOLD @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (depending what you need)
AFTER YOU HAVE ENOUGH RESOURSES ---->>> START AGE UP @age/age_3.webp@ AND:

/EITHER BRING VILLAGERS  @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ BACK FROM @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ @resource/resource_gold.webp@ TO @resource/resource_wood.webp@  AND RALLY GOLD @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_gold.webp@
/EITHER RALLY BOTH TC ON WOOD @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@
